svg.desc: Al-Laith Hospital LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT Saudi Ministry of Health COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2011 40 million EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Completed in 2011, this hospital project in Al-Laith was developed for the Saudi Ministry of Health. BECT provided architecture, structural and civil engineering, MEP, technical support and project management services for the healthcare facility, which had a construction value of 40 million EGP. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management.
